home_heroDescription: The first technology consultancy and custom software studio on the triple border of Brazil, Peru and Colombia. Built by Indigenous people and people born in the Upper Solimões, for organisations in every sector and for Indigenous peoples, here and in any country.
home_visionTitle: Those who live the context build the solution.
home_vision1Desc: We design for slow networks, shared devices and real field conditions, so products keep working where others fail.
home_vision2Desc: Respect for each people's culture, language and data. Clean code, documentation and training: communities and clients maintain what we deliver.
home_vision3Desc: Proven stacks chosen for the next five years, not the next trend.
home_processDesc: From first call to production, with the same team. Strategy, design and engineering, no handoffs.
home_step1Desc: We learn the business, review systems and processes, and define success before any code.
home_step2Desc: Architecture, stack choices, roadmap and clear estimates. You decide with the facts in hand.
home_step3Desc: Web, mobile and APIs shipped in short cycles, with a working version to try every week.
home_step4Desc: After launch we monitor, fix and improve. The product keeps getting better with use.
home_servicesHeading: Custom software, from consulting to a product in production.
home_serviceConsultingDesc: Technical assessments, architecture, stack choices and roadmaps. We help your organisation decide what to build before you spend on it.
home_teamTitle: Built by Indigenous people and locals.
home_teamDesc: Professional developers, designers and analysts, Indigenous and native to the Upper Solimões, in Benjamin Constant, on the triple border of Brazil, Peru and Colombia.
home_role1Desc: Systems, apps and infrastructure built to hold up in the field.
home_role2Desc: Clear interfaces for the people who use them, on any screen.
home_role3Desc: Data and processes understood before they become code.
home_ctaDesc: Tell us about your organisation's, company's, institution's or community's challenge. We reply within one working day.
home_serviceWebDesc: Fast, accessible web applications built to order with React and TypeScript, ready for slow connections and simple devices.
home_serviceMobileDesc: Cross-platform mobile with React Native. Native-grade feel, shared codebase, half the overhead.
home_serviceBackendDesc: Server-side systems built on AdonisJS, Fastify and Node.js. REST and realtime, built to outlast the trend cycle.
home_serviceDesignDesc: Interfaces with the accent of the people who use them. Accessible, specific and rooted in context, in Portuguese, Spanish, English and the community's own language when it asks.
home_serviceImpactDesc: Technology for Indigenous associations, organisations and institutions in Brazil, Peru, Colombia and other countries. Digital inclusion made with peoples, never about them.
home_selectedWorkDesc: A short list of projects we cared about making.
blog_description: Notes on technology, custom software and Indigenous peoples, written from the triple border.
blog_newsletterDesc: A quiet newsletter with the things we learn while building. No spam, no sales, just craft.
blogArticle_introText: The landscape of mobile development is shifting faster than ever. As we move further into the year, the focus has moved beyond mere functionality, toward seamless, scalable, and highly performant experiences.
blogArticle_section1Text: Monolithic apps are becoming harder to maintain at scale. Micro-frontends allow teams to work independently on different features of the app without interfering with each other's codebases.
blogArticle_bullet1: Faster iteration cycles across distributed teams.
blogArticle_bullet2: Isolation of bugs and performance issues.
blogArticle_bullet3: Ability to use different stacks for specialised features.
blogArticle_section2Text: Despite faster networks, user expectations for speed have skyrocketed. A delay of just 100ms can lead to significant drops in engagement.
blogArticle_quote: Scalability isn't just about handling more users, it's about maintaining consistent performance as complexity grows.
blogArticle_section3Text: Integrating machine learning directly into the mobile client allows for personalised experiences without the latency of cloud round-trips.
